height_policy: Use supplied height. Otherwise tagged number of floors times assumed3m; otherwise schematic6m. These are not surveyed building models or airflow inputs.
LOD_policy: Far: oriented bounding boxes of actual footprints. Near: original outer footprint extrusions, courtyard holes omitted in display; complete source geometry retained in GeoParquet.

actual_source_dataset.purpose: Real building display geometry only; running particle physics unchanged
